Mark (eng-platform): Quick sync — RCA-521 postmortem produced a short action list. Can folks confirm owners + realistic due dates here? I'll lock owners by EOD.

Mark (eng-platform): Actions:
1) Reduce noisy alerts: tune thresholds & add alert grouping
2) Add regional fallback routing for eu-west model variants
3) DB schema migration to enforce kv-cache TTL + cleanup job
4) Canary rollout script for dedupe hotfix (author + reviewer)
5) Post-deploy smoke tests + SLIs wired into Console

Priya (eng-sre): I'll take 1) — ETA 2026-05-02. Need Mark to post the current alert list/thresholds (or I can pull from grafana). :white_check_mark:

Diego (eng-runtime): I'll own 2). ETA 2026-04-30. Blocker: need routing policy matrix from Product (Jin). I also need a test cluster in eu-west to validate failover.

Hannah (eng-ml): For 3) I can write migration sanity tests and the cleanup job, target 2026-05-10 for test+staging. We need DBA to run the live migration window — tagging DB team via ops-bot.

Jin (product): I will deliver the routing policy matrix by EOD 2026-04-24. Will include success metrics for canary.

Priya (eng-sre): 4) Canary script: Diego to author, Priya to review. Diego, please open a draft PR and add ci smoke harness. Priya will review within 24h of draft.

Diego (eng-runtime): Draft PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/rollout/pull/42 — includes canary steps + smoke script. Please review, @Priya.

Priya (eng-sre): Quick review done, left one comment about timeout values in the script. Will approve after CI fixes. :eyes:

Mark (eng-platform): 5) Smoke tests & SLIs — Hannah to author test cases, Platform (me) will wire SLI dashboards and Console alerts. Target: 2026-05-07 to have tests in repo + dashboards created.

Hannah (eng-ml): Ack. I'll push prompt-suite and perf tests to repo by 2026-05-04.

DB-Bot (ops-bot): @Hannah migration window request queued: 2026-05-11 02:00 UTC. Reply with APPROVE to confirm scheduling.

Hannah (eng-ml): APPROVE — scheduling looks good from my side.

Mark (eng-platform): Thanks all. I'll create a single tracking ticket that lists owners/dates and link it to the RCA doc. If anyone needs to change a date, flag it here before I lock.

Priya (eng-sre): SRE ok with dates.

Jin (product): Product ok.

Diego (eng-runtime): Runtime good.

Hannah (eng-ml): All set.

Mark (eng-platform): Locked owners in tracking ticket: https://issues.redwood/RCA-521-actions. I'll add checkpoints next week. :thumbsup:
